comment: Pokermon 3.2.1 -> 3.9.1 batch 5 (Plans/MICATRO_MODS_UPGRADES.md section 3): which of 3.9.1's static-data changes to EXISTING jokers we take.
Read by tools/micatro/gen_pokermon_391_overlay.mjs, which writes micatro/mods/pokermon/data391.js. Never hand-edit data391.js: edit this file and regenerate.

take_always: pool / shop / sticker statics the engine reads with the same meaning whatever the joker does (rarity, cost, Perishable / Eternal eligibility, enhancement gates), and the Steamodded attributes 3.9.1 jokers declare (inert until 3.9.1 content draws from attribute pools). Taken for every existing joker.

take: per joker, the config paths and compat flags whose 3.9.1 value is read by OUR ported (3.2.1) logic with the same meaning: the joker's 3.9.1 calculate is a refactor of the 3.2.1 one (namespaces, SMODS.scale_card, return-table shape), not a rework.

reasons: why a joker's other changes wait (a rework: its upstream logic changed with the numbers). Every value change of a config key both versions have, and every blueprint_compat flip, must be taken or have a reason here, or the generator fails.
sprite_hold: jokers that keep their 3.2.1 sprite (and sheet).

rework_files (batch 6+): files whose jokers are ported to their 3.9.1 behaviour (jokers/<file>.js). Each existing joker there takes ALL its 3.9.1 static data: the whole config (config_all), every compat flag, its 3.9.1 Joker loc entry. take / reasons do not apply to them.
rework_hold: jokers of rework_files still on their 3.2.1 behaviour (with the reason; their static data goes through take / reasons as before).
loc_extra: other 3.9.1 loc entries the reworked jokers show, as Set.key (Other.<tooltip>, dictionary.<word>, v_dictionary.<word>).

rework_deferred (batch 7+): 3.9.1 changes to jokers of rework_files that are ported WITHOUT one part, because that part belongs to other content not ported yet (a new joker, an enhancement, a booster); the joker itself is on 3.9.1. Names must be 3.2.1 jokers; copied to data391.js rework_deferred for the docs and tests, inert.

batch 10: the Hazard layer / Seed card / Flower X2 landed; the 16 jokers that waited for them left rework_hold, and loc_extra pulls the 3.9.1 text of the new / changed non-joker content (enhancements, items, the Debris deck and sleeve, the Hazard Layer tooltip). Sets named by their 3.9.1 key (poke_item) are merged into our canonical set (Item) by index.js.

batch 10b: the Unown rework landed (Unown, Unown Swarm, Ruins of Alph's Unown spawn, Unown's 3.9.1 card) with the Wish Pack (Jirachi): rework_hold and sprite_hold are empty; Ruins of Alph and Jirachi left rework_deferred.

new_jokers (new-jokers stack, sub-batch 11+): {sub_batch: [names]} of jokers 3.9.1 adds; each takes its whole 3.9.1 static data, sprite, Joker loc entry and family (data391.js new_jokers / families; behaviour in jokers/<file>.js). new_deferred: {name: {why, drop}}: a new joker ported without one part that belongs to a later sub-batch; drop = static fields left out until then (e.g. the item_req of an item evolution into a joker not ported yet), text_drop = the text lines naming that part.

unregistered_sprites (sub-batch 15): jokers 3.9.1 writes (commented out) but never registers, which the port defines in full (Hisuian Qwilfish / Overqwil, as the 3.2.1 port did): they take only their 3.9.1 sprite (pokespriteload.lua lists them).

upstream_main (sub-batch 15b): jokers upstream added on main AFTER the 3.9.1 tag, pinned at one commit: {repo, commit, version (main's Pokermon.json version string), date, new_jokers {sub_batch: [names]}}. The generator reads them from a second extract (the main tree at that commit) and takes ONLY those jokers (static data, Joker loc entry, sprite, family, file order); every other change on main is drift for a later rebase (PORTING.md). Our version stays 3.9.1: contentRev counts them.

batch 16 (Megas): new_jokers "16" = the 11 Megas 3.9.1 adds. A reworked joker also takes its 3.9.1 megas list (the generator checks each Mega is registered), so Raichu / Clefable / Victreebel / Starmie / Dragonite / Meganium / Feraligatr / Skarmory / Lucario / Drampa link to theirs; Lucario / Skarmory left rework_deferred and Drampa new_deferred. loc_extra adds the Mega Berry Juice and the Mega deck / sleeve texts (3.9.1: + Crystal Ball, the sleeve alt).

batch 17 (the last 3.9.1 batch): new_jokers "17" = zotherjokers.lua's new non-Pokemon jokers (Rage Candy Bar, Bitter Rival, Champion, Imposter Professor, Daycare, Oologist) and zzzapril_fools.lua's three new April Fools jokers (Spiclops, Miror Budicolo, Capture Disc: registered by 3.9.1 only with the pokemon_aprilfools option; ours stay registered and are offered only with it). Repel is written but never registered by 3.9.1 (not in zotherjokers.lua's jlist): the port defines it in full. Rival and Mystery Egg left rework_deferred (Bitter Rival / Champion and the Oologist came). sprite_extra: a new joker whose 3.9.1 card is not on a PokemonSprites sheet: its own atlas (Miror Budicolo, Capture Disc: 3.9.1 pokesprites.lua) or a card composed by tools/micatro/compose_pokermon_joker_art.mjs (Rage Candy Bar: 3.9.1 draws placeholder_joker). loc_extra adds the 5 boss blinds, the Elite stake, the Starter Pack...? / Tag...?, the Ludicolo card, the 5 challenges' names and rules (misc v_text / challenge_names), the Obituary / Revenant sleeves' alt texts and Repel.

rework_deferred.porygonz: 3.9.1 reads G.GAME.consumeable_usage_total.poke_energy (Steamodded counts every set); ours keeps G.GAME.energies_used (every Energy used), like batch 6 kept the renamed poke_energy_plus / poke_scry_amount state

rage_candy_bar.why: 3.9.1 draws it with placeholder_joker (no art upstream): Micatro's card, composed by tools/micatro/compose_pokermon_joker_art.mjs (the Others sheet's white JOKER card + the overworld's Rage Candy Bar item icon)

miror_budicolo.why: 3.9.1 pokesprites.lua: its own 4-frame animation atlas (miror_budicolo.png, vendored in batch 5)

capture_disc.why: 3.9.1 pokesprites.lua: its own atlas (capture_disc.png, vendored in batch 5)
